perspective: Simulated newly diagnosed adult without stroke, phone user without identified access impairment; wants plain explanations, visible sources and one useful appointment question; prefers calm wording and dislikes jargon and repeated notices. Not patient testimony.

explanation.navigation: All nine menu destinations, header/footer, Home, urgent help, direct/reload, Back/Forward, legacy routes and an unavailable route exercised.
explanation.readingAccess: Text settings, section reading, keyboard focus/activation, pointer scroll and responsive viewports worked; audible playback/assistive technology not verified.
explanation.practicalUsefulness: No-stroke guide includes a useful follow-up question; sheet selection, notes, preview and export work.
explanation.dataOutputTrust: Local storage/export boundaries are explicit; synthetic outputs matched preview; saved hub is generic.
explanation.recoveryFromInterruption: All-saved-guide deletion had no confirmation/undo; other tested saved sheets/cards restored after reload and card deletion was cancelable.

verdict: 9/10. Useful and navigable in the simulated path, with one low-severity recovery barrier; no critical or confirmed clinical fault.
strengths: Calm, non-predictive no-stroke guide says ongoing questions and effects still matter.
A useful appointment question is offered: what follow-up is needed and what is its purpose?
Glossary gives short definitions, caveats and a way to prepare a clinician question.
Sources and review status are visible; the app states reviews are not recorded rather than implying approval.
Saved hub uses generic labels, and storage/export boundaries are explicit.
Appointment notes, support preferences, and card outputs preserve the synthetic content tested.
frustrations: Delete all saved guides removes the entire list immediately, without confirmation or undo.
Both downloaded PDFs repeat the disclaimer in the card content and page footer.
At 320px and 200% app text, the appointment heading occupies several short lines and navigation wraps, although no horizontal overflow occurs.
All seven guides visibly remain draft/review pending, with clinical/patient review and dates not recorded; this is transparent but may limit confidence for a newly diagnosed reader.

steps: Save two guides on this device.
findings.expected: A cancel opportunity or undo for removing the full list.
findings.actual: Both saved entries disappeared immediately; the empty-list prompt appeared with no confirmation or undo.
findings.note: The guides can be re-found and saved again, so this is not a critical lost-data fault.

findings.expected: Show the safety statement legibly without repeating it on the same card.
findings.actual: Each PDF includes the same disclaimer beneath its content and again in the footer.
findings.note: Minor duplication; it does not obscure content.
